ablations.bbs: bbnosize removed = P_nom (pp_r14_roll; re-read of existing rollouts); own metric bottle_hold_new
ablations.naf: aframe removed (object term retrained; target term reused); own metric s_known_new
ablations.nnm: bbnom removed (object term retrained; target term reused); own metric k5_hold_new
ablations.nts: tscale removed (target term retrained; object term reused from <cond>_nsz; full assembled from full_pdc's target term after one bitwise verification build); own metric n4_fam
ablations.rtc: rtclip removed: exactness check pp_cons_check.py (no GPU); own metric n4_fam

metrics.combined: every DROP removed at once; assembled from leave-one-out terms where possible, else its object term built once; read with the same rule (own metrics of every dropped option)
metrics.dependencies: rtclip's drop holds only with tscale on; if tscale is dropped, rtclip stays (it switches the per-part radial clip on). psupport stays in every arm
metrics.not_ablated: psupport, imode, rtransport, rank 32 (budget); decouple kept without ablation (measurement fix)
metrics.reference: P_nsz: --rank 32 --aframe --rtclip --psupport --tscale --decouple --imode --rtransport --bbnom --bbnosize; seeds 10-12; pp_r15_roll (P2nsz, Pnsz_<cond>_k<k>); S1 pp_s1_mix_full_nsz_m0-2
metrics.rule: removing an option WORSENS iff (a) its own metric or (b) familiar non-regression (pooled familiar K1-K6 success) has delta = arm - P_nsz < -0.10 with paired-state-bootstrap CI upper bound < 0, or (c) a GO item passing for P_nsz fails for the arm (items: S1 restated; OM per layout; 3F per layout and pairing N1-N6; S3 per atom and layout, passing iff all k in {1, 5, 10} cells meet ratio >= 0.8, LB >= 0.6). DROP iff not worsens, else KEEP
metrics.s1_restated: S1 holds iff, with every target part's m fixed to v for each v in the inventory, both swap tests and every target-into-grasp component are exactly 0 for every seed
metrics.states: dev: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds; S3 k in {1, 5, 10}
metrics.stop: if the minimal arm passes Layer-2 GO on dev (pp_l2 mapping, both layouts): stop and report; no confirmatory read in this phase
metrics.tiebreak: if the combined arm worsens: the single-option DROP arm with the most passing GO items, then higher pooled new-layout s new, then step-2 order (nts, naf, nnm); plus rtclip's exact drop where allowed; none: P_nsz
metrics.written_before: any build, check, S1 run, rollout or read of this phase
